samples.question: Starting at the red ring and reading toward the gold triangle, for every image column through the single dark ribbon outline, mark the point halfway between its upper and lower dark edges. Connect those halfway points in order without smoothing, then ignore overall position and tilt. Which path appears: arch, cup, or wave? An arch has a high middle and low ends; a cup has a low middle and high ends; a wave has one low and one high lobe. Answer ambiguous if the two best matches tie.
